answer: Proof of human-mediated stake functions as a robust Sybil deterrent for AI agent networks. By requiring a digital signature derived from a biological trait, akin to a unique pigment of an iris, each entity must anchor its identity to a costly, scarce resource. An attacker seeking to populate a virtual grove of agents must procure a physical quill to sign proofs, imposing a prohibitive hardware cost that renders identity flooding economically irrational compared to the value of honest participation.
